title: Customer account holds the computer image at runtime
description:
**Principle follow-through, not the `chatticus-8fe4c7e1-2043-442d-bc48-5350e7995f32` patch.**

Epic `chatticus-598be488-151d-4e57-8897-5cf6aaed50e5` decided 2026-09-07: a customer organization's account holds everything that organization's work depends on at runtime — image, files, compute.

`infra/customer-role.yml` already grants the full ECR push set (`CreateRepository`, `PutImage`, `InitiateLayerUpload`, `UploadLayerPart`, `CompleteLayerUpload`, `SetRepositoryPolicy`). `chatticus-82dab7c4-a44c-4e0e-ac19-51a0c7a12d09`'s who-creates-what table said the `:dev` image lands in **that** ECR under the assumed role. `infra/lib/customer-computers-stack.ts` instead `fromRegistry(anthusComputerImageUri)`.

Do not start this until `chatticus-8fe4c7e1-2043-442d-bc48-5350e7995f32` has a host that runs — two customer-visible computer-stack changes at once will blur the labeled stop. Template edits stay customer-visible.

```
Feature: The customer computer pulls an image from the customer's ECR

  Scenario: RunTask does not depend on Anthus registry reachability
    Given a customer ChatticusComputers stack
    When a computer host starts
    Then the task definition image URI is in CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID
    And the published role's push permissions are used, not leftover
```

comments.text:
Plan reviewed and **authorized** with two holes closed.

Worktree verified: `/tmp/chatticus-2b3c41-customer-ecr` on `feat/2b3c41-customer-ecr-image` (HEAD `ab92e29`, not the primary clone). Operator-script bootstrap (not Lambda copy), TenantId-only CreateStack, delete Anthus pull path, Gherkin migration of CREATE_COMPLETE + Anthus image parameter — those stand.

**Closed on authorize:**
1. **`fromEcrRepository` + CDK pull grant.** Do not hand-write one policy with `GetAuthorizationToken` on the repo ARN (that action is account-level). Do not keep the current execution-role `resources: ["*"]` ECR statement as a leftover.
2. **ComputerWorker never publishes.** Host start is `DescribeImages` then refuse if `:dev` is missing. `publish_dev_image_from_anthus` is for the operator script and Gherkin only.

`customer-role.yml` stays unmodified unless a real gap appears. No host-disk, no Dynamo on the task role, no live `browser_open` in this slice (ACME will refuse until the operator script runs after UpdateStack). Tear the worktree down only after the manager closes the issue.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
PR #320 reviewed, **not merged**. Request changes.

Live ECR `DescribeImages` with a missing `:dev` tag raises `ImageNotFoundException`. `customer_image_tag_exists` treats empty `imageDetails` as missing and never catches `ClientError`. `is_image_not_found_error` is defined and unused. `_FakeEcr` returns `{"imageDetails": []}`, so Gherkin stays green and ACME after UpdateStack would not get `OrganizationComputerProvisioningError`.

Fix: treat `ImageNotFoundException` / `RepositoryNotFoundException` as missing in the helper. Make the Gherkin fake raise like AWS so behave fails without that catch.

Also drop `project/wiki` from this product PR; the runbook step lands on `develop` as `pm:` after merge.
